copied_from_spikes.note: COPIED, not moved. PLAN 1.3 says the S2 subset moves into corpus B proper before Phase 2 closes; spikes/s2 is left intact so the spike record still runs.
copied_from_spikes.vendor/: spikes/s2/fixtures/vendor/ (React 18.3.1 and react-window 1.8.10 as UMD builds, so there is no build step and no network at run time)

generated_files.bigform.html: corpus/b/_generate.py, same reason: 320 controls are not reviewable by hand and a hand-maintained file that size drifts.
generated_files.dom50k.html: corpus/b/_generate.py. The generator writes the file and the FILE is committed, so the node count is a property of the bytes on disk rather than of how fast the machine ran. No inline script builds nodes.

network: none required. The two https://example.com iframes are expected to fail offline; the iframe ELEMENT is the fixture, not its content.
